diseases.name: Common Cold
diseases.description: A viral infection affecting the upper respiratory tract lines.

diseases.name: Influenza (Flu)
diseases.description: A contagious viral strain actively impacting the pulmonary and respiratory systems.
precautions: Consult clinical options regarding antiviral support

diseases.name: Gastroenteritis
diseases.description: An acute intestinal tract infection causing digestive system disruption.
precautions: Consume small amounts of electrolyte solutions

diseases.name: Migraine Episode
diseases.description: A neurological condition triggering severe, localized throbbing pain clusters.
precautions: Apply localized cold compresses to the forehead area

diseases.name: Allergic Rhinitis
diseases.description: An inflammatory responses to airborne particulates like pollen, dust, or dander.
precautions: Minimize exposure to identified environment triggers
